studentInput.content: 원 O에 내접하는 사각형 ABCD의 꼭짓점은 원주 위에 A, B, C, D 순서로 놓여 있다. \angle CAD=115^\circ, \angle ADC=40^\circ일 때, \angle ABD=x의 크기는? (4점)

independentDerivation.circle: Points B and C lie on the same segment of chord AD; ∠ABD and ∠ACD subtend the same chord AD, so they are equal.

choiceSweep.errorPath: Halve the 40° inscribed angle as though it were a central/arc conversion.
Matches both the triangle angle sum and equal same-chord inscribed angle.
Misread ∠CAD=115° as 110° before applying the triangle sum.
Double 40° to 80° as an arc value, then subtract 80° from 115° as if both were triangle angles.
Copy the marked ∠ADC instead of solving the other triangle angle and transferring it to the equal inscribed angle.

answerCardinality: PASS; five distinct numeric choices, exactly one equals 25°.

visualParity.actualObservation: Four circle points are cyclic A-B-C-D; angle labels are attached to vertices/rays; x is visibly at B.

sourceKeyDisposition: The original-source HWP ③ key belongs to the replaced item and remains preserved in sourceTruth; it does not determine this replacement.
